item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coast of southern China during the weekend and on Monday. It will be warm during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning and at night over the region.
